## 6-49

```{r}

ball_count <- 49
ball_game <- 6

ball_count_sequence <- seq(from = (ball_count - ball_game + 1), to = ball_count, by = 1)

permutations <- prod(ball_count_sequence) / factorial(ball_game)
permutations

```


## LottoMax

### original

```{r}

ball_count <- 50
ball_game <- 7

ball_count_sequence <- seq(from = (ball_count - ball_game + 1), to = ball_count, by = 1)

permutations <- prod(ball_count_sequence) / factorial(ball_game)
permutations

# 3 plays for $5
permutations / 3

```


### original

```{r}

ball_count <- 52
ball_game <- 7

ball_count_sequence <- seq(from = (ball_count - ball_game + 1), to = ball_count, by = 1)

permutations <- prod(ball_count_sequence) / factorial(ball_game)
permutations

# 4 plays for $6
permutations / 4


```
